headword: {国交断絶|こっこうだんぜつ}
gloss: severance of diplomatic relations; breaking off diplomatic ties

definitions.gloss: severance of diplomatic relations; breaking off diplomatic ties
definitions.explanation: The formal act of ending official diplomatic relations between two countries, typically by recalling ambassadors, closing embassies, and ceasing government-level contact. Usually taken as a strong protest in response to serious incidents, acts of aggression, or deep policy disputes.

examples.japanese: {国交断絶|こっこうだんぜつ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{宣言|せんげん}する→宣言する：21680_sengensuru⟧。
examples.english: To declare the severance of diplomatic relations.

examples.japanese: ⟦{両国|りょうこく}→両国：10010_ryoukoku⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{長年|ながねん}→長年：09684_naganen⟧{国交断絶|こっこうだんぜつ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{状態|じょうたい}→状態：03345_joutai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: The two countries have been in a state of severed diplomatic relations for many years.

examples.japanese: ⟦{事件|じけん}→事件：01568_jiken⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{受|う}けて→受ける：01215_ukeru⟧、⟦{政府|せいふ}→政府：03294_seifu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{相手国|あいてこく}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{国交断絶|こっこうだんぜつ}⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧{辞|じ}さない{構|かま}え⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見|み}せた→見せる：01988_miseru⟧。
examples.english: In response to the incident, the government signaled that it was prepared even to sever diplomatic relations with the other country.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{国交|こっこう}→国交：12015_kokkou⟧ (diplomatic relations, literally "country contact") and ⟦{断絶|だんぜつ}→断絶：12988_danzetsu⟧ (severance, cutoff). Refers to one of the most serious measures a country can take short of war: formally ending all official diplomatic channels, usually by withdrawing ambassadors and closing embassies.

USAGE:
- Typically appears in political and news contexts rather than everyday conversation.
- Often paired with ⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ to function verbally: ⟦{国交|こっこう}→国交：12015_kokkou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{断絶|だんぜつ}→断絶：12988_danzetsu⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to sever diplomatic relations).
- Contrasts with lesser measures such as recalling an ambassador for consultations, downgrading relations, or imposing sanctions — {国交断絶|こっこうだんぜつ} is the most severe diplomatic step.
- Citizens of the countries involved may lose consular protection after severance, so the term often appears alongside {在留邦人|ざいりゅうほうじん} (Japanese nationals abroad) in news reports.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {国交断絶|こっこうだんぜつ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{宣言|せんげん}する→宣言する：21680_sengensuru⟧: to declare the severance of diplomatic relations
- {国交断絶|こっこうだんぜつ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{踏|ふ}み{切|き}る→踏み切る：06237_fumikiru⟧: to go ahead with severing diplomatic relations
- {国交断絶|こっこうだんぜつ}⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧{辞|じ}さない: to be prepared even to sever ties
- {国交断絶|こっこうだんぜつ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{危機|きき}→危機：11798_kiki⟧: a crisis of severed relations
- {国交断絶|こっこうだんぜつ}⟦{状態|じょうたい}→状態：03345_joutai⟧: a state of severed diplomatic relations

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {国交回復|こっこうかいふく}: restoration of diplomatic relations — the opposite action
- {国交樹立|こっこうじゅりつ}: establishing diplomatic relations — setting up ties for the first time
- ⟦{断交|だんこう}→断交：21584_dankou⟧: severance of relations — a shorter, more formal synonym
- {経済制裁|けいざいせいさい}: economic sanctions — a less drastic alternative
- ⟦{大使|たいし}→大使：03391_taishi⟧{召還|しょうかん}: recall of an ambassador — a step below full severance
